personality_one_liner: A high-performance, command-center creator studio built for speed, contrast, and operational clarity.

spacing.rule: Use tight spacing for a dense, professional tool feel. Group related settings closely to optimize vertical real estate without scrolling.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary with dividers to separate content layers in this dark-first utility theme.
dont's: Avoid glassmorphism/blur as it softens the interface; this personality requires sharp, high-contrast, machine-fast surfaces.

screens.name: Create Reel (Compose)
screens.purpose: Primary workspace for prompt/script input and video configuration.

states.empty: N/A - Screen defaults to an active text area.
states.error: Inline error banner below text input if script generation fails.

screens.layout: Use a segmented control at the top to toggle between 'Paste Script' and 'Generate from Topic'. Below, a large surfaceTertiary text area that auto-expands. Below the input, horizontal scroll blocks (tiles) for Voice, Caption Style, and Background Gradient Theme. A persistent, full-width brandPrimary CTA ('Generate Reel') sits sticky at the bottom.

screens.name: Settings / Configurations (Bottom Sheet)
screens.purpose: Contextual menus for selecting Voice, Background Theme, and Captions without leaving the Create context.

states.error: Error loading assets with a retry button.

screens.layout: Triggered from the Create screen. List of selectable options (e.g., Voice Actors with small play icons). The selected item features a borderStrong outline. Backgrounds show abstract neon gradient thumbnails.

screens.name: Generation Progress
screens.purpose: Real-time, transparent tracking of the 4-stage pipeline render.

states.loading: N/A - This entire screen is a loading state.
states.error: Red error text on the failed pipeline stage, with a primary 'Retry' button at the bottom.

screens.layout: Dark abstract neon background (heavily blurred and overlaid with a dark gradient scrim). A vertical timeline or stacked progress module centers on the screen showing: Script -> Voice -> Captions -> Render. The active stage pulses gently. Fast, instant transition feel.

screens.name: Video Preview & Export
screens.purpose: Full-screen playback of the generated 9:16 vertical MP4 with export options.

states.error: Failed to load video, show retry button.

screens.layout: Edge-to-edge 9:16 vertical video player. A top navigation bar with a subtle back button. Center overlay for Play/Pause. A sticky bottom action bar (surfaceSecondary) housing 'Download MP4' and 'Share' buttons.

screens.name: Library (History)
screens.purpose: Archive of all past generated reels and their pipeline status.

states.empty: A dark studio microphone image, with text 'No reels generated yet.' and a CTA to 'Create Reel'.
states.error: Failed to load history, retry button.

screens.layout: 2-column masonry or grid layout of vertical thumbnails. Each card displays a status badge (e.g., brandTertiary pill with success/warning/error colors indicating Ready, Generating, or Failed) and the creation date. Cards use border styling (1pt border) rather than shadows.

empty_library.alt: Studio microphone against a dark backdrop

progress_bg_1.alt: Abstract purple and pink gradient waves

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility guidelines. Default to the DARK theme palette regardless of system settings, as this is a 'dark creator studio' app.
Do NOT use indigo, violet, purple, or any blue hues for UI elements per the NO TOLERANCE rule. The primary brand accent is Signal Red.
Typography MUST use Barlow Condensed for display/headings and Manrope for text/body. Ensure font weights do not exceed 500.
Use tight spacing, sharp corners (sm: 4, md: 8), and 1pt borders to separate elements instead of shadows or glassmorphism. This should feel like a machine-fast, pro operational tool.
The Create screen should feature a sticky primary CTA at the bottom, outside of the scrolling content, so users can 'Generate Reel' without scrolling.

On the Generation Progress screen, use the abstract gradient backgrounds provided in the images list, but ensure you apply a gradient scrim (top-to-bottom, ending at >=70% surfaceInverse) so the pipeline text remains completely readable.
When placing text over any image or thumbnail (like in the Library grid), a dark gradient scrim must be used behind the text.
Avoid glassmorphism. Use solid surfaceSecondary or surfaceTertiary containers for elevation and visual hierarchy.
